name: AgentTab
description: A refundable tab for an AI agent: lock a budget once, pay a provider with off-chain vouchers, settle once.

resources.name: Original AgentTab project
resources.description: The CashScript covenant, paywall server, MCP tools and web app that this template migrates.

owner.name: Tab owner
owner.description: Locks the budget for an agent and gets back whatever the agent did not spend.

provider.name: API provider
provider.description: Gets paid what the agent signed for, and nothing more.

openTab.name: Open a tab
openTab.description: Lock a budget for an agent, payable to one provider, refundable after a timeout.

owner.name: Fund the tab
owner.description: Choose the agent, the budget and the timeout, and fund the tab.

provider.name: Accept the tab
provider.description: Generate the key that settles or cancels this tab.

settle.name: Settle the tab
settle.description: Take the amount on the agent voucher. The rest goes back to the owner.

cancel.name: Cancel the tab
cancel.description: Waive the tab. The whole budget, minus the miner fee, goes back to the owner now.

refund.name: Refund the tab
refund.description: After the timeout, take the whole budget back (minus the miner fee).

openTabTransaction.name: Tab opened
openTabTransaction.description: Locked $(<budgetSatoshis>) satoshis in an AgentTab until block $(<timeoutBlockHeight>).

settleTransaction.name: Tab settled
settleTransaction.description: Paid $(<amountSatoshis>) satoshis to the provider and returned the rest to the owner.

cancelTransaction.name: Tab cancelled
cancelTransaction.description: Returned the budget to the owner.

refundTransaction.name: Tab refunded
refundTransaction.description: Returned the budget to the owner after the timeout.

providerPayoutOutput.name: Provider payment
providerPayoutOutput.description: $(<amountSatoshis>) satoshis owed, minus the miner fee.

ownerRemainderOutput.name: Unspent budget
ownerRemainderOutput.description: What the agent did not spend, returned to the owner.

ownerRefundOutput.name: Refunded budget
ownerRefundOutput.description: The budget returned to the owner, minus the miner fee.

agentTab.name: AgentTab covenant
agentTab.description: Pays the provider at most what the agent signed for and forces the rest back to the owner.

providerWallet.name: Provider wallet
providerWallet.description: P2PKH address of the provider key used in this tab.

ownerWallet.name: Owner wallet
ownerWallet.description: P2PKH address of the owner key used in this tab.

minerFeeSatoshis.name: Miner fee
minerFeeSatoshis.description: Fixed fee for settle, cancel and refund. The covenant caps the cancel fee at 1000 satoshis.

ownerKey.name: Owner key
ownerKey.description: Key of the tab owner. Receives the remainder and can refund after the timeout.

providerKey.name: Provider key
providerKey.description: Key of the API provider. Settles or cancels the tab and receives the payment.

agentPublicKey.name: Agent public key
agentPublicKey.description: The agent signs vouchers with this key. It can never withdraw from the tab.

timeoutBlockHeight.name: Timeout (block height)
timeoutBlockHeight.description: From this block on the owner can refund the whole tab. The provider must settle before it.

amountSatoshis.name: Voucher amount
amountSatoshis.description: The cumulative amount on the best voucher the provider holds.

voucher.name: Agent voucher
voucher.description: Schnorr data signature by the agent over "AGENTTAB" ++ tab outpoint ++ amount (8 bytes LE).
